name: opencode-connector
description: Delegate bounded, git-scoped review and coding tasks to the local OpenCode CLI from Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, or Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Delegate reviews and tasks to OpenCode.
interface.longDescription: Delegate bounded, git-scoped review and coding tasks to the local OpenCode CLI from Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, or Antigravity. Review is the default mode, runs with a read-only tool profile, and returns a schema-validated verdict with findings.
defaultPrompt: Ask OpenCode to review my uncommitted changes.
